Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Here is a proposal for you to review.

For 10 people, 4 hours per day, I suggest the Studio with a coffee break for every attendee. The Studio holds up to 12 people, so your group fits, and the 4-hour block matches what you asked for.



| Item | Detail | Price |
|---|---|---:|
| Studio (V1) | 4 hours | €240 |
| Coffee break (S1) | 10 people x €8 | €80 |
| **Total for ONE booking** (of 2 requested) | | **€320** |
| Budget | | €700 |
| Difference | | not comparable: the total covers one booking only |



Please note that these prices cover ONE booking (one day) only. You need two days, so the second day still has to be priced separately. Please don't read the table as the price for the whole event. On the table's figures, one day is within your budget, but I can't yet say whether both days together will be.

Assumptions in this proposal:
- You didn't mention accessibility, so I have assumed nobody needs wheelchair access. The Studio is reached by stairs only. If anyone needs a route without stairs, please tell me. The Loft is wheelchair accessible and holds up to 24 people.
- Only 4-hour bookings exist, and the proposal is based on that.

You asked for two consecutive days. Availability has to be checked separately, and nothing is held until then. This draft doesn't secure any dates.

Please let me know if you'd like to adjust anything, and I will take it from there.

Kind regards

Accessibility not stated: assumed no wheelchair access is needed. The Studio is stairs-only.
flags: Date/urgency request (two consecutive days): dates need a separate availability check. Nothing can be confirmed or booked from this draft.

Dates always need a separate availability check; nothing is booked or held.
No discounts of any kind are available.
